definitions.explanation: The ninth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly November 23 to December 21. Also the constellation Sagittarius. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{射手座|いてざ}です。

examples.english: Sagittarius people are said to love freedom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{射手座|いてざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}ける→開く：01979_hiraku⟧そうだ。
examples.english: This week's horoscope says Sagittarius's luck will open up if they go on a trip.

notes:
The zodiac sign Sagittarius, for people born from late November to late December.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {射手座|いてざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Sagittarius
- {射手座|いてざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Sagittarius
- {射手座|いてざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Sagittarius horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
